title: Fruit Ripeness Grouped CV Folds
subtitle: Near-duplicate groups and 5-fold splits for the five-fruit ripeness data
description: folds.csv: one row per image of the five fruit ripeness datasets, with its near-duplicate group (flip/rotation-invariant dHash, Hamming distance <= 6) and its stratified grouped 5-fold assignment (fold_all for the pooled data, fold_fruit per fruit). dl_baselines.py trains the deep-learning baselines on exactly these folds.
